name: v23-pseudo-rule-removed
change: The single CSS rule that paints the vertical timeline-connector tick before each non-last `<li>` in the 'bullets-rich-text-timeline' list (`.bullets-rich-text-timeline li:not(:last-child):before { content: ""; ... }`, golden/site/index.html lines 923-932) is deleted; every `<li>`, its text, and every other attribute on the page are byte-identical to golden.
edit: site/index.html: deleted the 10-line CSS rule block `.bullets-rich-text-timeline li:not(:last-child):before { content:""; position: absolute; top: .0625em; left: .6875em; width: 1.5px; height: 100%; background-color: #ecdcff; z-index: -1; }` (golden lines 923-932, in a `<style>` block embedded ahead of the 'Who we work for' timeline list). No other rule, element, or attribute touched: the adjacent `.bullets-rich-text-timeline li:not(:last-child){ padding-bottom: 2em; }` rule (no `content`, unrelated declaration) and the nested `@media screen and (min-width: 480px) { .bullets-rich-text-timeline li:not(:last-child):before { left: .5625em; } }` override (already inert without the deleted rule, matching the same 'leave dead sibling/override alone' pattern used elsewhere on this page) are left byte-identical. -204 bytes (131038 -> 130834).
knockOnEffects: The deleted rule's selector `li:not(:last-child)` matches THREE of the FOUR `<li>` items in the one `.bullets-rich-text-timeline` list on the page ('Sales teams', 'Marketing teams', 'Customer service & contact centers' -- not the fourth/last, 'IT & Operations teams', which the selector deliberately excludes and which never had a connector tick painted on golden either). OBSERVED on a full run (testbed/.runs/v23-pseudo-rule-removed/diff-result.json): exactly THREE `pseudo_element_missing` issues (warning severity), one per affected <li>, each anchored by that <li>'s own text via existing semantic-node matching (tier 'node' pseudo ownership) -- a single CSS-rule deletion painting three owners simultaneously produces three issues, not one. This is the deliberate, observed shape of this fixture (see expected-issues.json's required[] and maxIssues:3), not noise: no fourth issue for the last <li>, and zero missing_text/missing_image/style_changed noise elsewhere on the untouched page.

position:absolute + z-index:-1 on the deleted pseudo means it never affected layout/page height; removing it changes only whether a 1.5px-wide decorative tick is painted, not any box's geometry, so there is no page-height or reflow knock-on.
diffSummary: diff -rq reports only site/index.html differs from golden (-204 bytes, 131038 -> 130834). `diff -u` against golden shows exactly one contiguous 10-line hunk removed (the `.bullets-rich-text-timeline li:not(:last-child):before` rule, lines 923-932) and nothing else; every element, attribute, and asset is byte-identical to golden. An earlier attempt targeting `.lang-element-wrapper .w-icon-dropdown-toggle::before` (footer language-selector chevron, and its nav sibling `.nav-main .w-icon-dropdown-toggle::before`) was built, run, and discarded before this one: hiya-shared.min.css's page-wide Webflow base rule `.w-icon-dropdown-toggle:before{content:'\ue603'}` still paints those owners after their custom override is deleted (observed 9 style_changed issues, 0 pseudo_element_missing), so they cannot demonstrate 'attribute present, nothing painted'. See expected-issues.json's notes for the full rule-selection trail.
